notes.title: Important update in 2025.3.6
notes.notes:
Hello to all new players and old veterans alike. Our game has been updated.

We had to prioritize the contract for another game in 2024, so most of our manpower couldn't be allocated to this game, which resulted in this game not being updated for a ridiculous amount of time. We usually don't do this, and we sincerely apologize.

That said, we have not forgotten this game, nor do we plan on abandoning it. This update adds everything we had planned to add from the very beginning. In particular:

New Content

 New local co-op mode! No internet connection required. As long as you have purchased the game, you can play with up to 4 people on the same computer. When entering the character select screen, press a button on a controller to have 2P, 3P and 4P respectively join the battle.
 Added five new playable characters: Star, Lily White, Lily Black, Clownpiece, Larva, and their respective storylines! (Not unlocked by default; fulfill conditions to unlock)
 Added five new bosses: Aya Shameimaru, Shou Toramaru, Seija Kijin, Mayumi Joutouguu, Megumu Iizunamaru, and their respective maps.
 Previously unfinished achievements have all been added.
 You can now choose character colors. When selecting a character, you can select your desired character color palette before starting the game.
 Tons of new music. We'll be adding them to the OST soon, so if you've bought that, you'll be able to listen to all the new songs directly through the update.


We've also made over 150 fixes and improvements, which would be too looooooong to list here.

It has been some time without updates, after all, so feel free to treat it as a wholly new game.

With the release of this version, everyone we had originally planned for the game is now fully complete. For the future, we plan to continue fixing and improving the game based on player feedback. Once the game is translated into other languages, we'll do the official release.

I first started this game out of willfulness. I wanted a game where you could have fun with friends in any setting, whether it's a family gathering, conventions, dormitories, or anything else. With the project nearing its end, we'll be reclaiming all our feelings and energy and work hard to bring you even better games.

All in all, thank you for your support, and sorry for the wait.

notes.title: Important update, novice guide complete.
notes.notes:
RC0.2.0

Added new beginner tutorial levels (finally!).
Added sfxs to the explosive danmaku of the Moon Rabbit Fairy (all sfx will be gradually added later).
Password input box now displays asterisks.
Removed the lingering mechanism of Sakuya's throwing knives.
Increased the speed of Sanae’s swimming giant snake counterattack.
Okina’s backdoors will now only appear on the left half of the screen.
Reduced the lingering time of Mononobe no Futo's field flame to 3 seconds.
Hecatia's Earth Light skill now spawns at a distance twice as far from the player.
The score threshold for grading standards now varies based on the number of worlds cleared (n * 10000).

notes.title: Update Since 16 Agust 2023 CST
notes.notes:
Before the next major version update, we will keep using this thread for minor updates within this version. Please keep an eye on it.

Please restart Steam to get the latest update.

RC 0.1.0c update 23.8.16 16:43 CST

Remove player manual button
When playing in multiplayer mode, boss health now increases with the number of players.
Modify Luna's pixels to make it easier to distinguish different variants.
Fix the issue where sprint combo achievements and S-rank achievement were not unlocking inconsistently.
S-rank achievements now count for each world (not just the fifth world).
Increase the brightness of scorching sun weather.
Add in-game hints for item and weather prompts (can be turned on in settings).
Modify the level clearance rating conditions to make them more reasonable. 
Change the stopwatch's time-stop barrier to be released in place.
 Add a timer to items to despawn them after thirteen seconds of spawning.
 When the player or enemy is stunned, the damage hitbox now expands to the entire body.
 Localize the save name generator.
 Fix some UI overflow issues.
 Refactor some backend code to optimize performance.

---

RC 0.1.0b update 23.8.1 15:44 CST

1. “Player Manual” button now opens player manual directory instead of the pdf itself so as to avoid the problem of another pdf viewer programe not exiting when exiting the game, causing the Steam client to still think the game is running.

We will release new tutorial system with interactive levels in the near future, and remove the pdf manual from within the game.

---

RC 0.1.0a update 23.7.30  17:29 CST

1. Fixed an issue where the Steam client may not detect that the game has stopped after it is closed.
2. Fixed an issue where the game freezes due to csv parsing errors on systems with certain locales (e.g., French, German etc).
3. Localized the bug feedback template to English.
4. Added HD resolution (1280x720) and 4k resolution (3840x2160) for better devices support (BREAKING: users who have already selected a resolution may be affected after this update; please re-select and save the resolution preference).
5. Added VFXs to Okina’s familiars so its mechanism is less confusing.
6. Fixed a batch of issues with missing or incorrect descriptions.
7. Fixed an issue where clicking the background with the mouse causes the game to lose focus.
8. Fixed an issue where falling into the water while sprinting does not result in death.
9. Fixed an issue where there are no splash VFX when the player falls into the water in a dead state.
10. Greatly reduced the number of Sakuya's knives.
11. Fixed an issue where the "Slip and Slide" achievement requires opening the game a second time to trigger.
12. Fixed an issue where the "Go Get a Life" achievement cannot be unlocked.
13. Fixed an issue where the Nitendo Switch controller key icon is displayed incorrectly.
14. When pressing any keyboard and gamepad keys, mouse cursor would be moved to left bottom corner.
15. Greatly reduced the difficulty of Hecatia’s counterattack in her Earth mode.

---

RC 0.0.1-p4 update 23.7.29  14:50 CST

1. Fixed the problem where Steam Cloud Save could not synchronize.
2. Solved the problem where the a Chinese font could not be rendered correctly after the game had been running for a period of time.
3. Solved the problem where the game could get stuck when loading level 3-4 in Sunny EASY mode.
4. Solved the problem where the Miko Fairy's Yin Yang Ball and all items would not be automatically destroyed.

---

RC 0.0.1-p3  update 23.7.29  1:21 CST

1. Fixed the issue where the room list sometimes could not retrieve (or only retrieve a limited number of) rooms.
2. Fixed the description of the Chorus Fruit and the Suspicious Stew (for Chinese).
